  <script>
  // ---- Local offline shim for the YouTube Playables SDK (ytgame) ----
  // The real SDK is loaded from https://www.youtube.com/game_api/v1 and only
  // works when the game is actually embedded on youtube.com. This shim
  // implements the same API surface offline so the game doesn't crash when
  // it calls into it. Save/load data is backed by localStorage so progress
  // actually persists between sessions on this machine.
  (function () {
    var SAVE_KEY = "ytgame_offline_save";
    var audioCallbacks = [];
    var pauseCallbacks = [];
    var resumeCallbacks = [];

    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () {
      var list = document.hidden ? pauseCallbacks : resumeCallbacks;
      list.forEach(function (cb) { try { cb(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } });
    });

    window.ytgame = {
      IN_PLAYABLES_ENV: false,
      SDK_VERSION: "offline-shim-1.0",

      ads: {
        requestInterstitialAd: function () {
          return Promise.resolve();
        },
        requestRewardedAd: function (rewardId) {
          return Promise.resolve(true);
        }
      },

      engagement: {
        ContentType: { PLAYABLE: "PLAYABLE", VIDEO: "VIDEO" },
        openYTContent: function (content) {
          console.log("[ytgame shim] openYTContent (no-op offline)", content);
          return Promise.resolve();
        },
        sendScore: function (score) {
          console.log("[ytgame shim] sendScore (no-op offline)", score);
          return Promise.resolve();
        }
      },

      game: {
        firstFrameReady: function () {
          console.log("[ytgame shim] firstFrameReady");
        },
        gameReady: function () {
          console.log("[ytgame shim] gameReady");
        },
        loadData: function () {
          try {
            var data = window.localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
            return Promise.resolve(data === null ? "" : data);
          } catch (e) {
            return Promise.reject(e);
          }
        },
        saveData: function (data) {
          try {
            window.localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, data);
            return Promise.resolve();
          } catch (e) {
            return Promise.reject(e);
          }
        }
      },

      health: {
        logError: function () { /* no-op offline */ },
        logWarning: function () { /* no-op offline */ }
      },

      system: {
        getLanguage: function () {
          return Promise.resolve(navigator.language || "en-US");
        },
        isAudioEnabled: function () {
          return true;
        },
        onAudioEnabledChange: function (callback) {
          audioCallbacks.push(callback);
          return function () {
            audioCallbacks = audioCallbacks.filter(function (c) { return c !== callback; });
          };
        },
        onPause: function (callback) {
          pauseCallbacks.push(callback);
          return function () {
            pauseCallbacks = pauseCallbacks.filter(function (c) { return c !== callback; });
          };
        },
        onResume: function (callback) {
          resumeCallbacks.push(callback);
          return function () {
            resumeCallbacks = resumeCallbacks.filter(function (c) { return c !== callback; });
          };
        }
      }
    };
  })();
  </script>
